title: Integral trace equations at the given base orientation
statement: Fix the finite-field/coefficient setting $P$ of [def-pur-conventions], separated finite-type Noetherian $k$-schemes $X,Y$, and an open/proper factorization of a smooth separated quasi-compact locally finite-type $k$-morphism of pure dimension $d\ge0$, with the residue-field invertibility of $\ell$. Fix a specified exceptional coefficient System $S$. Using the literal model, trace and orientation definitions of [def-sp-field-extension-integral-models, def-pur-tower-trace-comparison-data], there exist a field-shriek model system $M$, its field-extension result $R$ and comparison stages $T_E$ for all finite coefficient fields $E$, such that each actual orientation has the prescribed finite unit reductions and is invertible; extension of the counit trace of the actual base-field orientation equals the counit trace of the actual orientation at $E$; and for every finite-Tor integral input $K$, tracePurity of this counitTrace equals the actual tower map. The same $M,R,T_E$ are used throughout. This asserts no integral/condensed adjunction transport, chart construction or uniformizer target comparison.

source.place: Steps 2--4, the actual realized tower map, unit trace and change of finite coefficient field

proof.text: Take the simultaneous model system and stages of lem-pur-tower-trace-purity-comparison. At the base coefficient field use its actual orientation itself as the input isomorphism: its invertibility and the prescribed reduction hypothesis are already supplied by the same theorem. Retain the resulting scalar-trace equality. In the integral component of the comparison conclusion substitute this equality; retain the prescribed orientations and the same model data. The rational and common-stage conclusions are not needed for this projection.

theorem normalized_integral_trace_data
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension d (j ≫ p)]
    [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Y]
    [QuasiCompact (j ≫ p)] [IsSeparated (j ≫ p)] [LocallyOfFiniteType (j ≫ p)]
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (P.coefficients.l : X.residueField x)]
    [∀ y : Y, Invertible (P.coefficients.l : Y.residueField y)]
    (S : ConstructibleExceptionalCoefficients.System P.coefficients.l P.coefficients.Qbar
      P.field P.coefficients.different (f := j ≫ p)) :
    ∃ (M : FieldShriekSystem.Models P)
      (R : FieldExtensionTowers.Result P M j p d)
      (T : ∀ E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P,
        TowerTracePurityComparison.Stage P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E)),
      (∀ E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P,
        TowerTracePurityComparison.PrescribedUnitReductions P j p d S.ring M E
          (R.model E) (T E)
          (TowerTracePurityComparison.orientation P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E)) ∧
        IsIso (TowerTracePurityComparison.orientation P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E))) ∧
      (∀ E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P,
        TowerTracePurityComparison.extendedTrace P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E)
            (TowerTracePurityComparison.counitTrace P j p d S.ring M
              (TowerTracePurityComparison.base P) (R.model (TowerTracePurityComparison.base P))
              (T (TowerTracePurityComparison.base P))
              (TowerTracePurityComparison.orientation P j p d S.ring M
                (TowerTracePurityComparison.base P)
                (R.model (TowerTracePurityComparison.base P))
                (T (TowerTracePurityComparison.base P)))) =
          TowerTracePurityComparison.counitTrace P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E)
            (TowerTracePurityComparison.orientation P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E))) ∧
      ∀ (E : FieldShriekSystem.Index P)
        (K : finiteTorConstructibleIntegralCategory P.coefficients.l E.val Y),
        TowerTracePurityComparison.tracePurity P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E)
            (TowerTracePurityComparison.counitTrace P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E)
              (TowerTracePurityComparison.orientation P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E))) K =
          TowerTracePurityComparison.tower P j p d S.ring M E (R.model E) (T E) K
